en: \[Cloud sessions] Changed `MCP_DISCOVERY_CACHE=1`, when set in your cloud environment's variables rather than a settings file, to reuse your connectors' tool lists after a session restart; other MCP servers are no longer cached and connect at startup
zh: \[Cloud sessions] 变更 `MCP_DISCOVERY_CACHE=1`：当它设置在云环境变量中而非设置文件中时，session 重启后会复用 connector 的工具列表；其他 MCP 服务器不再缓存，并在启动时连接
